src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2022_us_cd118_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 118th Congress's districts (its file says session 118).
rec: Hawaii Office of Elections, Notice of the final legislative and final congressional reapportionment plans adopted by the 2021 Reapportionment Commission, both filed Jan 28, 2022

Adopted and filed Jan 28, 2022 (late because the Census data came late); in effect for the 2022 elections. Census cb_2022 files hold the plans in effect for the 2022 election cycle, as submitted by the state's liaison (Census Redistricting Data Program pages).

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2022_us_sldu_500k
sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2022 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2022 legislative session year.
rec: Hawaii Office of Elections, Notice of the final legislative and final congressional reapportionment plans adopted by the 2021 Reapportionment Commission, both filed Jan 28, 2022

Adopted and filed Jan 28, 2022; the Chief Election Officer's notice says it governs the next five legislatures from filing. Census cb_2022 files hold the plans in effect for the 2022 election cycle, as submitted by the state's liaison (Census Redistricting Data Program pages).
